title: Kissed French Chicken Tagine
description: A quick-fix, high-protein French chicken tagine with coco sugar that delivers a silky, roasted flavor in a single pot.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper, cumin, coriander and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on all sides, about 4 minutes each side.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Add onion, carrot, and garlic to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, coco sugar and the remaining spices until fragrant, 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the pot, pour in chicken broth, bring to a simmer, cover, and bake for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the couscous and steam it in a separate pot for 5 minutes; fluff with a fork.
Serve the chicken over couscous, garnish with parsley, and enjoy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
